title: Wildlife Warfare
description:
Prepare for a thrilling multiplayer adventure where players choose their allegiance between two factions – animals or humans. Set in a world where animals have united to stand against relentless human hunters, pick sides and face off in a fierce battle for survival.

 

As an animal, play as an array of creatures—from fierce wolves, majestic tigers, and powerful bears to agile foxes, stealthy snakes, and even gigantic elephants. Each animal possesses unique characteristics that offer strategic advantages in the wild. 

Alternatively, become a human hunter equipped with an arsenal of weapons and tools, utilizing skill and cunning to overpower the fierce animal resistance. 

Face off in diverse environments including sprawling deserts, dense forests, lush jungles, and frigid arctic regions. Master the terrain and employ your instincts to outsmart your adversaries in this heart-pounding fight for survival. 

Engage in intense team deathmatch battles where collaboration and strategy are key. Work with your teammates to deplete the opposing team’s shared pool of lives and claim victory. Experience gameplay with satisfying combat, thrilling finishing moves, and the taste of sweet revenge. 

As more game modes are introduced, prepare for even greater challenges and opportunities to prove your worth. Will you join the animal resistance or stand with the humans? Choose your faction, and unleash your fury.
description_short: PLAY AS WILD ANIMALS OR HUMANS AND FIGHT AGAINST ONE ANOTHER. EITHER AGAINST BOTS, OR PLAYERS.
